#| label: visor-maestro
import contextlib
import io
import math
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import folium
import pandas as pd
from branca.element import MacroElement
from folium.plugins import Fullscreen
from folium.template import Template
from folium.utilities import image_to_url

ROOT = Path.cwd()
if not (ROOT / "src").exists():
    ROOT = ROOT.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from src.data import lake_reader
from src.geo.map_components import capas_poligonos

OMS = ["Buena", "Moderada", "Dañina (sensible)", "Dañina", "Muy dañina", "Peligrosa"]
OMS_COLORES = {
    "Buena": "#2d6a4f",
    "Moderada": "#ee9b00",
    "Dañina (sensible)": "#ca6702",
    "Dañina": "#bb3e03",
    "Muy dañina": "#9d0208",
    "Peligrosa": "#6a040f",
}

fechas = lake_reader.listar_fechas_disponibles("serving", "indicador_diario")
ult = fechas[-1] if fechas else "s/d"
_log = io.StringIO()
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(_log):
    hist = lake_reader.leer_rango_fechas(fechas[0], ult) if fechas else pd.DataFrame()
if hist.empty:
    print("[visor] Sin datos en el lake. " + _log.getvalue()[:600])
base = hist[hist["fecha"] == ult].copy() if not hist.empty else pd.DataFrame()

_origen_puntos = hist if not hist.empty else base
puntos_df = (
    _origen_puntos[["punto_id", "ciudad", "pais", "region", "lat", "lon"]]
    .drop_duplicates("punto_id")
    .reset_index(drop=True)
    if not _origen_puntos.empty
    else pd.DataFrame(columns=["punto_id", "ciudad", "pais", "region", "lat", "lon"])
)
pidx = {pid: i for i, pid in enumerate(puntos_df["punto_id"])}


def num(x):
    if x is None or pd.isna(x):
        return None
    return float(x)


fidx = {f: i for i, f in enumerate(fechas)}
obs = []
for _, r in hist.iterrows():
    pid = pidx.get(r["punto_id"])
    if pid is None:
        continue
    cat = r.get("categoria_pm25_aqi")
    cat_i = OMS.index(cat) if isinstance(cat, str) and cat in OMS else -1
    cuenca = 0
    if "es_cuenca" in r and not pd.isna(r["es_cuenca"]):
        cuenca = 1 if bool(r["es_cuenca"]) else 0
    obs.append([
        pid,
        fidx[r["fecha"]],
        num(r.get("pm25_media")),
        cat_i,
        num(r.get("us_aqi_max")),
        num(r.get("temp_media_c")),
        num(r.get("precipitacion_mm")),
        num(r.get("viento_max_kmh")),
        num(r.get("caudal_m3s")),
        cuenca,
    ])

datos = {
    "fechas": fechas,
    "puntos": [
        {
            "c": r["ciudad"],
            "p": r["pais"],
            "r": r["region"],
            "la": float(r["lat"]),
            "lo": float(r["lon"]),
        }
        for _, r in puntos_df.iterrows()
    ],
    "obs": obs,
    "oms": OMS,
    "colores": [OMS_COLORES[c] for c in OMS],
}

g_paises, g_urbanas, g_cuencas = capas_poligonos()

m = folium.Map(
    location=[-12, -62],
    zoom_start=3,
    tiles=None,
    control_scale=True,
    preferCanvas=True,
    scrollWheelZoom=False,
    min_zoom=2,
)
for g in (g_paises, g_cuencas, g_urbanas):
    if g:
        g.add_to(m)

idw_path = Path(lake_reader.LAKE_DIR) / "serving" / "superficies" / f"fecha={ult}" / "pm25.png"
capas = {
    "paises": g_paises.get_name() if g_paises else None,
    "cuencas": g_cuencas.get_name() if g_cuencas else None,
    "urbanas": g_urbanas.get_name() if g_urbanas else None,
    "idw_url": image_to_url(str(idw_path)) if idw_path.exists() else None,
}

items_oms = "".join(
    f"<div><span class='dot' style='color:{c}'>●</span> {k}</div>" for k, c in OMS_COLORES.items()
)
panel_html = """
<div class="eco-hd">
  <div>
    <div class="eco-kicker">EcoPulso · visor ambiental</div>
    <div class="eco-title">Red de monitoreo</div>
  </div>
  <button type="button" class="eco-min" id="eco-collapse" aria-label="Contraer panel">−</button>
</div>
<div class="eco-body" id="eco-body">
  <div class="eco-field">
    <div class="eco-lab">Dominio</div>
    <div class="eco-seg" id="eco-dominio">
      <button type="button" data-v="aire" class="on">Aire</button>
      <button type="button" data-v="clima">Clima</button>
      <button type="button" data-v="agua">Agua</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="eco-field">
    <div class="eco-lab">Región</div>
    <div class="eco-seg" id="eco-region">
      <button type="button" data-v="todos" class="on">Todas</button>
      <button type="button" data-v="LatAm">LatAm</button>
      <button type="button" data-v="Mundo">Mundo</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="eco-field">
    <div class="eco-lab">Fecha <span id="eco-fecha-val" class="eco-val"></span></div>
    <div class="eco-fecha">
      <button type="button" id="eco-play" class="eco-play" aria-label="Reproducir serie">▶</button>
      <input type="range" id="eco-fecha" min="0" max="13" step="1" value="13">
    </div>
    <div class="eco-hint" id="eco-fecha-hint">Serie histórica</div>
  </div>
  <div class="eco-field">
    <div class="eco-lab">Explorar ciudad</div>
    <select id="eco-ciudad" class="eco-select">
      <option value="">Red completa</option>
    </select>
  </div>
  <div class="eco-field">
    <div class="eco-lab">Capas del territorio</div>
    <div class="eco-check-grid">
      <label class="eco-check"><input type="checkbox" id="eco-paises" checked> Países</label>
      <label class="eco-check"><input type="checkbox" id="eco-cuencas" checked> Cuencas</label>
      <label class="eco-check"><input type="checkbox" id="eco-urbanas" checked> Áreas urbanas</label>
      <label class="eco-check"><input type="checkbox" id="eco-idw"> IDW PM2.5</label>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="eco-field">
    <div class="eco-lab">Opacidad polígonos <span id="eco-op-val" class="eco-val">35%</span></div>
    <input type="range" id="eco-op" min="0" max="100" step="5" value="35">
  </div>
  <div class="eco-field">
    <div class="eco-lab">Mapa base</div>
    <select id="eco-base" class="eco-select">
      <option value="claro">Claro</option>
      <option value="satelite">Satélite</option>
      <option value="calles">Calles</option>
      <option value="oscuro">Oscuro</option>
    </select>
  </div>
  <div class="eco-stats" id="eco-stats"></div>
  <div class="eco-source">Open-Meteo · GloFAS · Natural Earth · HydroBASINS</div>
</div>
"""

leyenda_html = f"""
<details open>
  <summary>Leyenda</summary>
  <div class="eco-lg-body">
    <div class="eco-lg-t">PM2.5 · categoría AQI</div>
    {items_oms}
    <div class="eco-lg-t">Temperatura</div>
    <div class="eco-grad"></div>
    <div class="eco-grad-lab"><span>0 °C</span><span>35 °C</span></div>
    <div class="eco-lg-t">Agua</div>
    <div class="eco-lg-note">Tamaño del círculo = caudal (escala log)</div>
    <div class="eco-lg-t">Polígonos</div>
    <div><span class='dot' style='color:#0b3d2e'>■</span> Países</div>
    <div><span class='dot' style='color:#1d6fa5'>■</span> Cuencas</div>
    <div><span class='dot' style='color:#7b6d8d'>■</span> Áreas urbanas</div>
  </div>
</details>
"""


class EcoVisor(MacroElement):
    _template = Template(
        """
        {% macro header(this, kwargs) %}
        <style>
        .eco-panel{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e6e8e6;border-radius:16px;
          box-shadow:0 12px 34px rgba(11,61,46,.20);width:292px;
          max-height:calc(100vh - 90px);overflow:auto;font-family:Inter,system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;
          color:#1f2937;font-size:13px;line-height:1.45}
        .eco-panel *{box-sizing:border-box}
        .eco-hd{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;
          padding:12px 14px 9px;border-bottom:1px solid #eef1ef;position:sticky;top:0;
          background:#fff;z-index:2;border-radius:16px 16px 0 0}
        .eco-kicker{font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#52796f}
        .eco-title{font-family:Fraunces,Georgia,serif;font-size:20px;font-weight:700;color:#0b3d2e;line-height:1.15}
        .eco-min{border:0;background:#eef3f1;color:#0b3d2e;width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:8px;
          font-size:18px;line-height:1;cursor:pointer}
        .eco-panel.collapsed .eco-body{display:none}
        .eco-body{padding:10px 14px 12px}
        .eco-field{margin-bottom:10px}
        .eco-lab{font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.09em;text-transform:uppercase;
          color:#6b7280;margin-bottom:5px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}
        .eco-val{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:#0b3d2e;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0}
        .eco-seg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:4px;background:#f1f4f2;
          padding:3px;border-radius:10px}
        .eco-seg button{border:0;background:transparent;border-radius:7px;padding:6px 4px;
          font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;color:#4b5563;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit}
        .eco-seg button.on{background:#0b3d2e;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(11,61,46,.25)}
        .eco-fecha{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
        .eco-play{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:9px;border:1px solid #d1d5db;background:#fff;
          color:#0b3d2e;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;flex:0 0 auto}
        .eco-fecha input[type=range],.eco-field input[type=range]{width:100%;accent-color:#0b3d2e;cursor:pointer}
        .eco-hint{font-size:10.5px;color:#8a938f;margin-top:3px}
        .eco-check{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:3px 0;font-size:12px;
          color:#374151;cursor:pointer}
        .eco-check input{accent-color:#0b3d2e;width:14px;height:14px;margin:0}
        .eco-check input:disabled+span{opacity:.45}
        .eco-check-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:0 8px}
        .eco-select{width:100%;padding:6px 8px;border:1px solid #d1d5db;border-radius:9px;
          font-family:inherit;font-size:12.5px;background:#fff;color:#1f2937}
        .eco-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:2px;background:#f4f8f6;
          border:1px solid #e3ece7;border-radius:11px;padding:8px 10px;margin-top:4px;
          font-size:12px;color:#374151}
        .eco-stats b{color:#0b3d2e}
        .eco-source{font-size:10px;color:#9aa39f;margin-top:8px;line-height:1.3}
        .eco-legend-box{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e6e8e6;border-radius:12px;
          box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(11,61,46,.14);font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;
          font-size:12px;color:#374151;max-width:225px}
        .eco-legend-box details{margin:0}
        .eco-legend-box summary{cursor:pointer;padding:9px 12px;font-weight:800;color:#0b3d2e;
          list-style:none;font-size:12px}
        .eco-legend-box summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
        .eco-legend-box summary::after{content:" ▾";color:#52796f}
        .eco-legend-box details:not([open]) summary::after{content:" ▸"}
        .eco-lg-body{padding:0 12px 11px}
        .eco-lg-t{font-size:9.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.09em;text-transform:uppercase;
          color:#6b7280;margin:9px 0 4px}
        .eco-lg-note{font-size:11px;color:#6b7280}
        .eco-legend-box .dot{margin-right:5px;font-size:12px}
        .eco-grad{height:9px;border-radius:5px;margin:5px 0 2px;
          background:linear-gradient(90deg,#2166ac,#67a9cf,#fee08b,#f46d43,#b2182b)}
        .eco-grad-lab{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:10px;color:#8a938f}
        .eco-pop{font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;color:#1f2937;min-width:190px}
        .eco-pop-h{font-weight:800;color:#0b3d2e;border-bottom:1px solid #e6e8e6;
          padding-bottom:5px;margin-bottom:6px;font-size:14px}
        .eco-pop-h span{font-weight:500;color:#6b7280;font-size:11px;margin-left:5px}
        .eco-pop table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse}
        .eco-pop td{padding:2px 0;vertical-align:top}
        .eco-pop td:last-child{text-align:right}
        .eco-pop-f{color:#9aa39f;font-size:10.5px;margin-top:6px;border-top:1px solid #eef1ef;padding-top:5px}
        @media (max-width:640px){
          .eco-panel{width:min(86vw,292px);max-height:calc(100vh - 70px)}
          .eco-legend-box{display:none}
        }
        </style>
        {% endmacro %}
        {% macro script(this, kwargs) %}
        (function(){
          var mapObj = {{this._parent.get_name()}};
          var D = {{this.datos|tojson}};
          var C = {{this.capas|tojson}};
          var PANEL = {{this.panel_html|tojson}};
          var LEYENDA = {{this.leyenda_html|tojson}};

          var ESRI_LIGHT = 'https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/Canvas/World_Light_Gray_Base/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}';
          var ESRI_LIGHT_REF = 'https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/Canvas/World_Light_Gray_Reference/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}';
          var ESRI_DARK = 'https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/Canvas/World_Dark_Gray_Base/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}';
          var ESRI_DARK_REF = 'https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/Canvas/World_Dark_Gray_Reference/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}';
          function esri(url, maxNative){
            return L.tileLayer(url, {attribution:'Tiles &copy; Esri', maxNativeZoom:maxNative, maxZoom:19});
          }
          var BASES = {
            claro: L.layerGroup([esri(ESRI_LIGHT,16), esri(ESRI_LIGHT_REF,16)]),
            satelite: esri('https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Imagery/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}',19),
            calles: L.tileLayer('https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', {attribution:'&copy; OpenStreetMap contributors', maxZoom:19}),
            oscuro: L.layerGroup([esri(ESRI_DARK,16), esri(ESRI_DARK_REF,16)])
          };
          var baseActual = null;
          function setBase(k){
            if (baseActual) { mapObj.removeLayer(baseActual); }
            baseActual = BASES[k] || BASES.claro;
            baseActual.addTo(mapObj);
          }
          setBase('claro');

          function capa(k){ var n = C[k]; return n ? window[n] : null; }
          var POLY = {paises: capa('paises'), cuencas: capa('cuencas'), urbanas: capa('urbanas')};
          var PESO = {paises: 0.35, cuencas: 0.55, urbanas: 0.85};
          var vis = {paises: true, cuencas: true, urbanas: true};
          var opacidad = 0.35;

          function zoomFactor(k){
            var z = mapObj.getZoom();
            if (k === 'cuencas') { return z >= 8 ? 0.35 : 1.0; }
            if (k === 'urbanas') { return z >= 8 ? 1.0 : 0.55; }
            return 1.0;
          }

          function pintaPoly(){
            ['paises','cuencas','urbanas'].forEach(function(k){
              var g = POLY[k];
              if (!g) { return; }
              if (!vis[k]) { if (mapObj.hasLayer(g)) { mapObj.removeLayer(g); } return; }
              if (!mapObj.hasLayer(g)) { g.addTo(mapObj); }
              if (g.setStyle) { g.setStyle({fillOpacity: opacidad * PESO[k] * zoomFactor(k), opacity: 0.95}); }
              if (g.bringToBack) { g.bringToBack(); }
            });
          }
          mapObj.on('zoomend', pintaPoly);

          var idw = null;
          if (C.idw_url) {
            mapObj.createPane('ecoIdw');
            mapObj.getPane('ecoIdw').style.zIndex = 350;
            idw = L.imageOverlay(C.idw_url, [[-56,-120],[33,-30]], {pane:'ecoIdw', opacity:0.62, interactive:false});
          }
          var idwOn = false;

          var canvas = L.canvas({padding: 0.5});
          var markers = null;
          var dominio = 'aire';
          var region = 'todos';
          var fechaIdx = D.fechas.length - 1;

          function isNum(v){ return v !== null && v !== undefined && !isNaN(v); }
          function fmt(v, d){
            if (!isNum(v)) { return 's/d'; }
            var n = Number(v);
            return n.toFixed(d === undefined ? 1 : d);
          }
          function esc(s){
            return String(s === null || s === undefined ? '' : s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, function(c){
              return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'}[c];
            });
          }
          function median(a){
            if (!a.length) { return null; }
            var b = a.slice().sort(function(x,y){ return x-y; });
            var m = Math.floor(b.length/2);
            return b.length % 2 ? b[m] : (b[m-1] + b[m]) / 2;
          }
          function tempColor(t){
            var stops = [[0,'#2166ac'],[10,'#67a9cf'],[18,'#fee08b'],[26,'#f46d43'],[35,'#b2182b']];
            if (t <= stops[0][0]) { return stops[0][1]; }
            for (var i=1;i<stops.length;i++){
              if (t <= stops[i][0]) {
                var a = stops[i-1], b = stops[i];
                var f = (t - a[0]) / (b[0] - a[0]);
                var ca = parseInt(a[1].slice(1),16), cb = parseInt(b[1].slice(1),16);
                var r = Math.round(((ca>>16)&255) + f * (((cb>>16)&255) - ((ca>>16)&255)));
                var gg = Math.round(((ca>>8)&255) + f * (((cb>>8)&255) - ((ca>>8)&255)));
                var bl = Math.round((ca&255) + f * ((cb&255) - (ca&255)));
                return 'rgb(' + r + ',' + gg + ',' + bl + ')';
              }
            }
            return stops[stops.length-1][1];
          }

          function popupHTML(p, o){
            var rows = [];
            if (dominio === 'aire') {
              rows.push(['PM2.5', fmt(o[2],1) + ' µg/m³']);
              rows.push(['Categoría', D.oms[o[3]] || 's/d']);
              rows.push(['AQI US máx.', fmt(o[4],0)]);
            } else if (dominio === 'clima') {
              rows.push(['Temp. media', fmt(o[5],1) + ' °C']);
              rows.push(['Precipitación', fmt(o[6],1) + ' mm']);
              rows.push(['Viento máx.', fmt(o[7],1) + ' km/h']);
            } else {
              rows.push(['Caudal', fmt(o[8],0) + ' m³/s']);
              rows.push(['Tipo', o[9] ? 'Cuenca' : 'Ciudad']);
            }
            var tr = rows.map(function(r){
              return '<tr><td>' + r[0] + '</td><td><b>' + r[1] + '</b></td></tr>';
            }).join('');
            return '<div class="eco-pop"><div class="eco-pop-h">' + esc(p.c) +
              '<span>' + esc(p.p) + '</span></div><table>' + tr + '</table>' +
              '<div class="eco-pop-f">' + D.fechas[fechaIdx] + '</div></div>';
          }

          var panel = L.control({position: 'topright'});
          panel.onAdd = function(){
            var div = L.DomUtil.create('div', 'eco-panel leaflet-control');
            div.innerHTML = PANEL;
            L.DomEvent.disableClickPropagation(div);
            L.DomEvent.disableScrollPropagation(div);
            return div;
          };
          panel.addTo(mapObj);
          var panelEl = panel.getContainer();

          var legend = L.control({position: 'bottomleft'});
          legend.onAdd = function(){
            var div = L.DomUtil.create('div', 'eco-legend-box leaflet-control');
            div.innerHTML = LEYENDA;
            L.DomEvent.disableClickPropagation(div);
            L.DomEvent.disableScrollPropagation(div);
            return div;
          };
          legend.addTo(mapObj);

          function q(sel){ return panelEl.querySelector(sel); }
          function qa(sel){ return Array.prototype.slice.call(panelEl.querySelectorAll(sel)); }

          if (window.innerWidth < 640) {
            panelEl.classList.add('collapsed');
            q('#eco-collapse').textContent = '+';
            region = 'LatAm';
            qa('#eco-region button').forEach(function(x){
              x.classList.toggle('on', x.getAttribute('data-v') === 'LatAm');
            });
          }

          function updateFecha(){
            q('#eco-fecha-val').textContent = D.fechas[fechaIdx];
            q('#eco-fecha').value = fechaIdx;
          }

          function statsHTML(vals, prs){
            var n = vals.length;
            if (!n) { return '<div>Sin datos para este filtro.</div>'; }
            if (dominio === 'aire') {
              var mx = Math.max.apply(null, vals);
              return '<div><b>' + n + '</b> puntos con dato</div>' +
                     '<div>Mediana <b>' + fmt(median(vals),1) + '</b> µg/m³</div>' +
                     '<div>Máximo <b>' + fmt(mx,1) + '</b> µg/m³</div>';
            }
            if (dominio === 'clima') {
              var avg = vals.reduce(function(a,b){ return a+b; }, 0) / n;
              var tot = prs.reduce(function(a,b){ return a+b; }, 0);
              return '<div><b>' + n + '</b> puntos con dato</div>' +
                     '<div>Temp. media <b>' + fmt(avg,1) + '</b> °C</div>' +
                     '<div>Lluvia total <b>' + fmt(tot,1) + '</b> mm</div>';
            }
            var qmx = Math.max.apply(null, vals);
            return '<div><b>' + n + '</b> puntos con caudal</div>' +
                   '<div>Mediana <b>' + fmt(median(vals),0) + '</b> m³/s</div>' +
                   '<div>Máximo <b>' + fmt(qmx,0) + '</b> m³/s</div>';
          }

          function syncIdw(){
            if (!idw) { return; }
            var show = idwOn && dominio === 'aire' && fechaIdx === D.fechas.length - 1;
            if (show && !mapObj.hasLayer(idw)) { idw.addTo(mapObj); }
            if (!show && mapObj.hasLayer(idw)) { mapObj.removeLayer(idw); }
          }

          function fitRegion(){
            var b = L.latLngBounds([]);
            D.puntos.forEach(function(p){
              if (region === 'todos' || p.r === region) { b.extend([p.la, p.lo]); }
            });
            if (b.isValid()) {
              mapObj.fitBounds(b.pad(0.10), {maxZoom: region === 'todos' ? 2 : 4});
            }
          }

          function render(){
            if (markers) { mapObj.removeLayer(markers); }
            var arr = [], vals = [], prs = [];
            D.obs.forEach(function(o){
              if (o[1] !== fechaIdx) { return; }
              var p = D.puntos[o[0]];
              if (!p) { return; }
              if (region !== 'todos' && p.r !== region) { return; }
              var v, color, rad;
              if (dominio === 'aire') {
                v = o[2];
                if (!isNum(v)) { return; }
                color = D.colores[o[3]] || '#6c757d';
                rad = 4 + Math.min(v, 150) / 18;
              } else if (dominio === 'clima') {
                v = o[5];
                if (!isNum(v)) { return; }
                color = tempColor(v);
                rad = 4 + Math.min(o[6] || 0, 60) / 10;
                prs.push(o[6] || 0);
              } else {
                v = o[8];
                if (!isNum(v)) { return; }
                color = '#01497c';
                rad = 3 + 2.2 * Math.log10(1 + v);
              }
              var mk = L.circleMarker([p.la, p.lo], {
                radius: rad, color: color, weight: 1.2, fillColor: color,
                fillOpacity: 0.86, renderer: canvas
              });
              mk.bindTooltip(esc(p.c) + ' · ' + fmt(v, dominio === 'agua' ? 0 : 1), {direction:'top', sticky:true});
              mk.bindPopup(popupHTML(p, o), {maxWidth: 300});
              arr.push(mk);
              vals.push(v);
            });
            markers = L.layerGroup(arr).addTo(mapObj);
            q('#eco-stats').innerHTML = statsHTML(vals, prs);
            q('#eco-idw').disabled = !idw || !(dominio === 'aire' && fechaIdx === D.fechas.length - 1);
            syncIdw();
          }

          qa('#eco-dominio button').forEach(function(b){
            b.addEventListener('click', function(){
              qa('#eco-dominio button').forEach(function(x){ x.classList.remove('on'); });
              b.classList.add('on');
              dominio = b.getAttribute('data-v');
              render();
            });
          });
          qa('#eco-region button').forEach(function(b){
            b.addEventListener('click', function(){
              qa('#eco-region button').forEach(function(x){ x.classList.remove('on'); });
              b.classList.add('on');
              region = b.getAttribute('data-v');
              citySel.value = '';
              render();
              fitRegion();
            });
          });

          var range = q('#eco-fecha');
          range.max = D.fechas.length - 1;
          range.addEventListener('input', function(){
            fechaIdx = parseInt(range.value, 10);
            updateFecha();
            render();
          });

          var timer = null;
          var play = q('#eco-play');
          play.addEventListener('click', function(){
            if (timer) {
              clearInterval(timer); timer = null; play.textContent = '▶';
            } else {
              play.textContent = '❚❚';
              timer = setInterval(function(){
                fechaIdx = (fechaIdx + 1) % D.fechas.length;
                updateFecha();
                render();
              }, 1300);
            }
          });

          ['paises','cuencas','urbanas'].forEach(function(k){
            var box = q('#eco-' + k);
            box.checked = vis[k];
            box.addEventListener('change', function(){ vis[k] = box.checked; pintaPoly(); });
          });
          var idwBox = q('#eco-idw');
          idwBox.addEventListener('change', function(){ idwOn = idwBox.checked; syncIdw(); });

          var op = q('#eco-op');
          op.value = Math.round(opacidad * 100);
          q('#eco-op-val').textContent = op.value + '%';
          op.addEventListener('input', function(){
            opacidad = parseInt(op.value, 10) / 100;
            q('#eco-op-val').textContent = op.value + '%';
            pintaPoly();
          });

          var baseSel = q('#eco-base');
          baseSel.addEventListener('change', function(){ setBase(baseSel.value); });

          var citySel = q('#eco-ciudad');
          D.puntos.map(function(p, i){ return {p: p, i: i}; })
            .sort(function(a, b){ return a.p.c.localeCompare(b.p.c, 'es'); })
            .forEach(function(item){
              var opt = document.createElement('option');
              opt.value = item.i;
              opt.textContent = item.p.c + ' · ' + item.p.p;
              citySel.appendChild(opt);
            });
          citySel.addEventListener('change', function(){
            if (citySel.value === '') { fitRegion(); return; }
            var p = D.puntos[parseInt(citySel.value, 10)];
            if (p) { mapObj.flyTo([p.la, p.lo], 10, {duration: 1.1}); }
          });

          q('#eco-collapse').addEventListener('click', function(){
            panelEl.classList.toggle('collapsed');
            q('#eco-collapse').textContent = panelEl.classList.contains('collapsed') ? '+' : '−';
          });

          updateFecha();
          q('#eco-fecha-hint').textContent = D.fechas.length + ' fechas disponibles';
          pintaPoly();
          render();
          fitRegion();
        })();
        {% endmacro %}
        """
    )

    def __init__(self, datos, capas, panel_html, leyenda_html):
        super().__init__()
        self._name = "EcoVisor"
        self.datos = datos
        self.capas = capas
        self.panel_html = panel_html
        self.leyenda_html = leyenda_html


EcoVisor(datos, capas, panel_html, leyenda_html).add_to(m)

Fullscreen(position="topleft", title="Pantalla completa",

## 02 · Pulso diario de la red

```{python}
#| label: pulso-diario
from plotly.subplots import make_subplots
import plotly.graph_objects as go

if not hist.empty:
    h = hist.copy()
    h["fecha_dt"] = pd.to_datetime(h["fecha"])

    pm = h.dropna(subset=["pm25_media"]).groupby(["fecha_dt", "region"])["pm25_media"].median().reset_index()
    tp = h.dropna(subset=["temp_media_c"]).groupby(["fecha_dt", "region"])["temp_media_c"].median().reset_index()
    ca = h.dropna(subset=["caudal_m3s"]).groupby(["fecha_dt", "region"])["caudal_m3s"].median().reset_index()

    colores = {"LatAm": "#0b3d2e", "Mundo": "#ee9b00"}
    fig = make_subplots(rows=1, cols=3,
                        subplot_titles=("PM2.5 mediana (µg/m³)", "Temperatura media (°C)", "Caudal mediano (m³/s)"))
    for reg, color in colores.items():
        d = pm[pm["region"] == reg]
        fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=d["fecha_dt"], y=d["pm25_media"], mode="lines+markers",
                                 name=reg, legendgroup=reg, line=dict(color=color, width=2),
                                 marker=dict(size=4)), row=1, col=1)
        d = tp[tp["region"] == reg]
        fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=d["fecha_dt"], y=d["temp_media_c"], mode="lines+markers",
                                 name=reg, legendgroup=reg, showlegend=False,
                                 line=dict(color=color, width=2), marker=dict(size=4)), row=1, col=2)
        d = ca[ca["region"] == reg]
        fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=d["fecha_dt"], y=d["caudal_m3s"], mode="lines+markers",
                                 name=reg, legendgroup=reg, showlegend=False,
                                 line=dict(color=color, width=2), marker=dict(size=4)), row=1, col=3)
    fig.update_layout(height=360, margin=dict(l=40, r=20, t=55, b=40),
                      legend=dict(orientation="h", y=-0.18, x=0))
    fig.update_yaxes(type="log", row=1, col=3)
    fig.show(config={"responsive": True, "displaylogo": False})
```

## 03 · Cruces que explican la contaminación

<div class="analisis-dedicado">

¿El calor y la lluvia mueven la contaminación? Dos cruces con la guía OMS como referencia.

</div>

```{python}
#| label: cruzados-maestro
import plotly.express as px

_necesarias = {"temp_media_c", "pm25_media", "precipitacion_mm", "us_aqi_max"}
if base.empty or not _necesarias.issubset(base.columns):
    print("<p class='visor-nota'>No hay datos suficientes para los cruces de esta fecha.</p>")
else:
    cru = base.dropna(subset=["temp_media_c", "pm25_media"])
    fig1 = px.scatter(cru, x="temp_media_c", y="pm25_media", color="region", hover_name="ciudad",
                      title="Temperatura media vs PM2.5",
                      labels={"temp_media_c": "Temperatura media (°C)", "pm25_media": "PM2.5 (µg/m³)"},
                      color_discrete_map={"LatAm": "#0b3d2e", "Mundo": "#ee9b00"})
    fig1.add_hline(y=15, line_dash="dash", line_color="#2d6a4f",
                   annotation_text="Guía OMS 24h: 15 µg/m³")
    fig1.update_layout(height=420, margin=dict(l=50, r=20, t=75, b=40))
    fig1.show(config={"responsive": True, "displaylogo": False, "modebarButtonsToRemove": ["lasso2d", "select2d"]})

    cru2 = base.dropna(subset=["precipitacion_mm", "us_aqi_max"])
    fig2 = px.scatter(cru2, x="precipitacion_mm", y="us_aqi_max", color="region", hover_name="ciudad",
                      title="Precipitación vs AQI máximo",
                      labels={"precipitacion_mm": "Precipitación (mm)", "us_aqi_max": "AQI US máximo"},
                      color_discrete_map={"LatAm": "#0b3d2e", "Mundo": "#ee9b00"})
    fig2.update_layout(height=420, margin=dict(l=50, r=20, t=75, b=40))
    fig2.show(config={"responsive": True, "displaylogo": False, "modebarButtonsToRemove": ["lasso2d", "select2d"]})
```

> **Fuentes:** Open-Meteo (meteorología y calidad del aire), GloFAS (caudal), Natural Earth (países y áreas urbanas) e HydroBASINS (cuencas). Los polígonos son contexto geoespacial; la superficie IDW se calcula solo para la fecha más reciente.
